gpt_native.note: reference arm: NOT part of the selection rules; shown on the selected tasks only. The selection (ids, ranks, tiers, reasons) is identical with or without it.

deepseek_mcp.label: DeepSeek + MCP
deepseek_mcp.description: text-only model + Eden AI MCP (7-tool catalogue; any other Eden AI tool reachable through search_tools / run_tool); the model decides whether and what to call

gemini_native.label: Gemini native
gemini_native.description: natively multimodal model; image or audio delivered as a native content part; no tools

gpt_native.label: GPT native
gpt_native.description: natively multimodal model; image or audio delivered as a native content part; no tools; OCR / vision only

selection.note: Curated subset: every selected task is one where DeepSeek+MCP did at least as well as Gemini native. It is not an unbiased sample of the source runs; full_run_context.json holds the complete picture.

tiers.label: deepseek_better
tiers.description: both arms scored; DeepSeek+MCP has the strictly higher score

tiers.label: equal_cheaper
tiers.description: same non-zero score; DeepSeek+MCP used less time, fewer tokens or a lower gateway charge

tiers.label: equal_full_score
tiers.description: both arms scored the maximum (both correct / both F1 = 1)

tiers.label: gemini_no_answer
tiers.description: DeepSeek+MCP scored the maximum; Gemini returned no scorable answer

tiers.label: equal_partial
tiers.description: both arms scored the same score below the maximum

excluded.gemini_better: Gemini has the strictly higher score
excluded.deepseek_partial_gemini_failed: DeepSeek+MCP below maximum and Gemini not scored

selection.orderWithinTier: gateway-cost ratio, then latency ratio, then token ratio (DeepSeek+MCP / Gemini, ascending), then id

mmmu_pro.title: OCR / vision
mmmu_pro.prompt: Write out the multiple-choice question in the image and then solve it. The last line of your response should be of the following format: 'Answer: $LETTER' (without quotes) where LETTER is one of options. Think step by step before answering.
